---
Title : Power under HA
---

## Setup

```{r}
library(here)
library(furrr)
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(arrow)
library(rstanarm)
library(glue)
library(fs)
```

## Simulation function

```{r}
run_simulation_iteration <- function(iter_num, base_path, data_path) {
    # This function runs one full simulation iteration.
    set.seed(456 + iter_num) # Set seed for reproducibility

    # --- 1. Setup for the current iteration ---
    iter_path <- file.path(base_path, glue("run_{iter_num}"))
    if (!dir.exists(iter_path)) {
        dir.create(iter_path, recursive = TRUE)
    }

    # --- 2. Sample Patient IDs ---
    patient_info <- arrow::open_dataset(data_path) |>
        select(pat_id, tx) |>
        distinct() |>
        collect()

    tx_ids <- sample(patient_info$pat_id[patient_info$tx == 1], size = 180, replace = FALSE)
    soc_ids <- sample(patient_info$pat_id[patient_info$tx == 0], size = 90, replace = FALSE)
    selected_pat_ids <- c(tx_ids, soc_ids)

    # --- 3. Load ONLY the required subset of data ---
    data_for_model <- arrow::open_dataset(data_path) |>
        filter(pat_id %in% selected_pat_ids) |>
        collect() |>
        rename(id = pat_id) |>
        filter(y == 5 | day == 182) |>
        group_by(id) |>
        arrange(desc(y)) |>
        slice_head(n = 1) |>
        ungroup() |>
        mutate(death = ifelse(y == 5, 1, 0)) |>
        select(id, tx, day, death, ecog_fstcnt, diagnosis)

    # --- 4. Save the data used for model fitting ---
    saveRDS(data_for_model, file.path(iter_path, "data_for_model.rds"))

    # --- 5. Fit the Model ---
    model <- tryCatch({
        stan_surv(
            formula = Surv(day, death) ~ tx,
            data = data_for_model,
            basehaz = "ms",
            basehaz_ops = list(df = 5),
            chains = 4,
            cores = 1,
            seed = 1234,
            iter = 2000
        )
    }, error = function(e) {
        message(glue("ERROR in iteration {iter_num}: {e$message}"))
        saveRDS(data_for_model, file.path(iter_path, "problematic_data.rds"))
        return(NULL)
    })
    
    # --- 6. Save results ONLY if the model ran successfully ---
    if (!is.null(model)) {
        # --- 6a. Save MCMC draws and diagnostics ---
        draws <- as.data.table(as.data.frame(model))
        saveRDS(draws, file.path(iter_path, "model_draws.rds"))
        
        model_summary <- summary(model)
        
        rhat_values <- as.data.frame(t(model_summary[, "Rhat"]))
        saveRDS(rhat_values, file.path(iter_path, "rhat_values.rds"))
        
        n_eff <- as.data.frame(t(model_summary[, "n_eff"]))
        saveRDS(n_eff, file.path(iter_path, "n_eff.rds"))

        # --- 6b. Calculate and Save RMST ---
        # Get posterior survival curves for tx=0
        ps_0_list <- posterior_survfit(
            model,
            newdata = data_for_model |> mutate(tx = 0),
            times = 0,
            extrapolate = TRUE,
            standardise = TRUE,
            control = list(edist = 182, epoints = 200),
            return_matrix = TRUE,
            draws = 4000
        )
        std_surv_matrix_0 <- do.call(cbind, ps_0_list)
        time_points <- sapply(ps_0_list, attr, "times")

        # Get posterior survival curves for tx=1
        ps_1_list <- posterior_survfit(
            model,
            newdata = data_for_model |> mutate(tx = 1),
            times = 0,
            extrapolate = TRUE,
            standardise = TRUE,
            control = list(edist = 182, epoints = 200),
            return_matrix = TRUE,
            draws = 4000
        )
        std_surv_matrix_1 <- do.call(cbind, ps_1_list)

        # Calculate RMST for tx=0 using trapezoidal rule
        delta_t <- diff(time_points)
        s_t1_0 <- std_surv_matrix_0[, -ncol(std_surv_matrix_0)]
        s_t2_0 <- std_surv_matrix_0[, -1]
        trapezoid_areas_0 <- 0.5 * (s_t1_0 + s_t2_0) * matrix(delta_t, nrow = nrow(s_t1_0), ncol = length(delta_t), byrow = TRUE)
        rmst_0 <- rowSums(trapezoid_areas_0)

        # Calculate RMST for tx=1
        s_t1_1 <- std_surv_matrix_1[, -ncol(std_surv_matrix_1)]
        s_t2_1 <- std_surv_matrix_1[, -1]
        trapezoid_areas_1 <- 0.5 * (s_t1_1 + s_t2_1) * matrix(delta_t, nrow = nrow(s_t1_1), ncol = length(delta_t), byrow = TRUE)
        rmst_1 <- rowSums(trapezoid_areas_1)

        # Calculate the difference
        rmst_diff <- rmst_1 - rmst_0
        
        # Combine and save results
        rmst_results <- data.table(rmst_0, rmst_1, rmst_diff)
        saveRDS(rmst_results, file.path(iter_path, "rmst_results.rds"))
    }
    
    # Return a status message for progress tracking
    return(glue("Iteration {iter_num} completed."))
}
```

## Run Simulation

```{r}
# Define the path to the full dataset
DATA_FILE_PATH <- here("3-survival", "sim-data", "ha_09.parquet")
# Define the base output path for simulation results
OUTPUT_PATH <- here("3-survival", "output", "sim-HA-09")

# Create the output directory if it doesn't exist
if (!dir.exists(OUTPUT_PATH)) {
    dir.create(OUTPUT_PATH, recursive = TRUE)
}
```


```{r}
# --- Simulation Parameters ---
N_SIMULATIONS <- 300
N_CORES <- 8 

message("Checking for previously completed simulation runs...")

# Find iterations that have already completed successfully
completed_files <- fs::dir_ls(path = OUTPUT_PATH, glob = "*/model_draws.rds", recurse = TRUE)

completed_iters <- integer(0)
if (length(completed_files) > 0) {
    completed_iters <- stringr::str_extract(completed_files, "(?<=run_)\\d+") |>
        as.integer() |>
        na.omit() |>
        unique()
}

# Determine which iterations still need to be run
all_possible_iters <- 1:N_SIMULATIONS
iters_to_run <- setdiff(all_possible_iters, completed_iters)

n_to_run <- length(iters_to_run)
n_completed <- length(completed_iters)

message(glue("{n_completed} of {N_SIMULATIONS} iterations are already complete."))
t1 <- Sys.time()

if (n_to_run > 0) {
    message(glue("Starting {n_to_run} new simulations on {N_CORES} cores..."))
    
    # Setup parallel processing backend
    future::plan(future.callr::callr, workers = N_CORES)
    
    # --- Run Simulations in Parallel ---
    furrr::future_walk(
        .x = iters_to_run,
        .f = ~run_simulation_iteration(
            iter_num = .x,
            base_path = OUTPUT_PATH,
            data_path = DATA_FILE_PATH
        ),
        .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE),
        .progress = TRUE
    )
    
    message(glue("Finished {n_to_run} simulations."))
} else {
    message("All simulations were already complete. No new runs started.")
}

t2 <- Sys.time()
message("Simulation process finished.")
# --- Duration of Simulation ---
print(t2 - t1)
```
